items.step: Bootstrap monorepo root, git hygiene, and durable st plan
Import seq/lift/cas into apps/ with minimal churn
Create libs/core shared Zig helpers and wire cas/lift/seq to reuse
Add root build.zig emitting separate CLI binaries
Add independent per-CLI CI/release workflows and path filters
Run validation matrix for each CLI and shared core
Write migration and release docs including separate tap guidance
Add canonical VERSION files for seq/lift/cas
Normalize per-CLI release artifact naming convention
Enforce tag-to-version checks in release workflows
Update release docs and validate workflow YAML + release builds
Create baseline commit and per-CLI tags in skills-zig for Homebrew git sourcing
Repoint seq/lift/cas Homebrew formulas to skills-zig tags and root build steps
Reinstall tap formulas and verify /opt/homebrew symlinks resolve to skills-zig-derived builds
Create and publish GitHub repo tkersey/skills-zig with version tags
Switch tap formulas to GitHub repo/tag sources (no local file URL)
Reinstall and verify Homebrew-only non-local formula sourcing
Commit and push homebrew-tap formula updates for skills-zig 0.2.1
Implement mesh streaming runtime contract v2 (lane expansion + csv/parser updates)
Release mesh runtime update and propagate homebrew tap formula
Add read-only Codex state SQLite helper and deterministic state DB discovery for seq
Implement memory_stage1_outputs and memory_extensions datasets with fail-closed schema/path handling
Implement memory-provenance and memory-map commands with shared proof-path contract
Implement memory-history command as observed evidence timeline

proof.command: zig build test && ./zig-out/bin/seq memory-history thread+topic smokes

items.step: Update seq help, README, command-surface gate, and .dotfiles seq skill for the new archaeology suite
Run fixture coverage plus live ~/.codex smoke commands to drive the suite to fixed-point closure
